title: Queued delayed commands
purpose: Explain article's cooperative active-object queue and elapsed-time requeue logic.
alt: ActiveObjectEngine 큐에서 DelayedTyper와 SleepCommand를 실행하고 경과 시간에 따라 자신 또는 깨울 명령을 재등록하는 구조
requiredChecks: ActiveObjectEngine owns a Command queue; addCommand(c) appends, run() removes first and calls execute() until queue empty.
SleepCommand and DelayedTyper implement Command.execute(); the engine does not implement Command.
DelayedTyper.execute() prints mChar; when !stop it queues new SleepCommand(mDelay, engine, this).
SleepCommand first records startTime and requeues itself; before delay expiry requeues itself; after expiry queues wakeupCommand.
No sleeping worker threads are implied; this example repeatedly polls/requeues on one engine loop.
